note: This is the formula-registry manifest referenced by FORMULA_REGISTRY_VERSION in supabase/functions/_shared/analysis-snapshot.ts -- the version that actually gets persisted per-analysis in production. It is distinct from src/lib/formula-registry.ts, an older, separately-versioned runtime registry (register/execute/testAll) whose cac_payback/payback_months entries are not called by the live analyze-business pipeline. version stays 1.0.0 in this update: no formula's behavior changed, only this manifest's coverage of already-existing formulas was completed (2026-08-23) -- a real version bump belongs to an actual formula/contract change, not a documentation-completeness pass.

metrics.definition: First fractional month in which cumulative free cash flow, including the month-zero initial investment outflow, reaches zero.
metrics.fallbackBehavior: Return typed NOT_ACHIEVED_WITHIN_HORIZON; never return 999, Infinity, or a fabricated month count.
metrics.edgeFunctionPort: supabase/functions/analyze-business/payback-contract.ts (cross-check only, non-fatal, logged as warning on drift -- never replaces the ramp-aware integer computation in index.ts)

metrics.definition: First fractional month in which cumulative contribution margin from the acquired customer or cohort recovers eligible acquisition cost.
metrics.fallbackBehavior: Return typed unavailable state with reason code when contribution series is absent or payback is outside the horizon.
metrics.note: This function is not currently ported to the edge-function side (no cac-payback-contract.ts equivalent to payback-contract.ts) -- unlike investment_payback_months, there is no live cross-check for this metric in the analyze-business pipeline today.

metrics.definition: Total contribution (revenue minus variable costs) divided by revenue.
metrics.fallbackBehavior: NOT_MEANINGFUL semantics via a null ratio (never a divide-by-zero or a fabricated 0) when revenue is zero.

metrics.definition: Fixed costs divided by contribution per unit. Requires unitsSold and pricePerUnit inputs to be provided.
metrics.fallbackBehavior: Typed NOT_ACHIEVABLE when contribution per unit is non-positive; typed INSUFFICIENT_INPUTS when no per-unit basis was provided.

metrics.definition: Fixed costs divided by contribution margin ratio.
metrics.fallbackBehavior: Typed NOT_ACHIEVABLE when contribution margin ratio is non-positive.

metrics.definition: Expected sales minus break-even revenue, both as an absolute amount and as a percentage of expected sales.
metrics.fallbackBehavior: Typed NOT_MEANINGFUL when expected sales is zero or negative; typed INSUFFICIENT_INPUTS when break-even revenue is unavailable.

metrics.definition: Total contribution divided by operating income.
metrics.fallbackBehavior: Typed NOT_MEANINGFUL when operating income is within 0.5% of revenue (mathematically unstable near zero), per an explicit numeric guard-band rather than an unflagged near-infinite figure.

metrics.definition: Gross profit (revenue minus COGS) divided by revenue.
metrics.fallbackBehavior: Typed NOT_MEANINGFUL (not a silent 0%) when revenue is zero.
metrics.note: Additive to, not a replacement for, the engine's existing grossMarginPercent field (financial-calculator.ts), which silently returns 0 on zero revenue -- documented here as a known divergence, not yet reconciled.

metrics.fallbackBehavior: Typed NOT_MEANINGFUL when revenue is zero.
metrics.note: operatingIncome and netIncome are currently the same value in the live engine -- no separate D&A/interest/tax layer exists yet. The result's operatingEqualsNetIncome field makes this explicit rather than silently presenting two independently-derived figures.

metrics.fallbackBehavior: Typed NOT_MEANINGFUL when revenue is zero.

metrics.definition: Total debt divided by total equity.
metrics.fallbackBehavior: ALWAYS returns INSUFFICIENT_INPUTS today -- the engine collects no debt schedule, interest expense, or separate equity/asset tracking at all. Per the explicit CTO-verdict rule ('typed unavailable states over fabricated proxies'), this is a reviewed spec awaiting the relevant intake fields, not a bug.

metrics.definition: Total debt divided by total assets.
metrics.fallbackBehavior: ALWAYS returns INSUFFICIENT_INPUTS today -- see debt_to_equity's note; same missing-inputs class.

metrics.definition: Total debt divided by total debt plus total equity.
metrics.fallbackBehavior: ALWAYS returns INSUFFICIENT_INPUTS today -- see debt_to_equity's note.
ALWAYS returns INSUFFICIENT_INPUTS today -- the engine has no EBITDA layer distinct from net income.
ALWAYS returns INSUFFICIENT_INPUTS today -- no interest expense is collected.

metrics.definition: Debt service coverage ratio: net operating income divided by total debt service.
metrics.fallbackBehavior: ALWAYS returns INSUFFICIENT_INPUTS today -- no debt service schedule is collected.

specOnlyNotLive.reason: Requires a full three-statement model (depreciation, amortization, interest expense, taxes, capex, debt principal/new-debt/new-equity) that the live engine (analyze-business/financial-calculator.ts) deliberately does not compute -- no depreciation schedule, debt structure, or tax rate exists anywhere in the live path. Kept as a reviewed, correct spec for a future engine, not active production code. Has no FORMULA_ID and is intentionally excluded from the metrics list above, which documents only formulas actually reachable from a real analysis today.
